text: Karla is a playable character in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade. She is the emotionally distant, naïve and cool-natured sister of Karel, known as the Princess of Swords.

The M134 "Minigun" is a 7.62mm NATO, multi-barrel rotary machine gun with a high rate of fire (up to 6,000 rounds per minute), employing Gatling-style rotating barrels with an external power source. It is featured in several installments of the Battlefield series as a mounted machine gun on vehicles.

Kanae Urabe is an NPC that appears in Tokyo Mirage Sessions ♯FE. She is a classmate of Itsuki Aoi that believes she has psychic powers. Over the course of the game, she provides Itsuki with various side quests, asking him to track down items she sees as present at specific locations within the Idolaspheres. Itsuki consistently finds items at the locations Kanae hints at, suggesting that she does in fact have powers of premonition.
Larentia is a playable character from TearRing Saga: Berwick Saga. She is a Peshiran dragon knight who was forced to abandon her country because she disagreed with its alliance with the Raze Empire.
Maximum Ambulation is the Unique Action Ability of Ferdinand in Fire Emblem Warriors: Three Hopes.

The M2 Browning is an American heavy machine gun designed in 1918 by John Browning. It has been the primary heavy machine gun of the United States Armed Forces since the end of World War I and is still in service in Iraq and Afghanistan. It continues to be used by its customers due to its reliability and because of the .50 BMG cartridge the weapon uses.

Mila is a non-playable character from Fire Emblem Gaiden and its remake, Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia. Along with her elder brother Duma, she is one of two sibling gods who resides at the continent of Valentia. Mila is the patron deity of Zofia, known as the Earth Mother, and her blessing helps crops grow on the earth.

Mios is a background character from TearRing Saga: Utna Heroes Saga. He was the Sage of Light, one of the Four Sages who studied under the White Master Morse. He was also a priest of the Temple of Water and one of the Twelve Heroes who fought in the Leda Liberation War. Upon his return to Reeve, he banished his son, Naris, who had kidnapped Maeve with the intention of using her for his own political ambitions. He was later slain by Gwenchaos with the ★Zahhak spell.
Mitama is a playable child character in Fire Emblem Fates. She is the daughter of Azama.

The M14 is an American selective-fire battle rifle derived from the M1 Garand. It fires 7.62x51mm NATO cartridges. It was the standard issue rifle for the U.S. Armed forces from 1957, replacing the M1 Garand, to 1970, being replaced by the M16. It was used extensively during the Vietnam era, but was phased out very quickly during and after that conflict. Post-Vietnam, some marksman rifles, like the Mk. 14 EBR and M39 EMR were derived from the M14 platform and still see usage in the modern day. The Springfield Armory M1A SOCOM 16 is a civilian derivative of the M14. The SRSS Bulldog is a civilian bullpup chassis for the M14.

Nergal is the main antagonist of Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade. He is a druid who seeks to open the Dragon's Gate and bring dragons back to Elibe to harvest their quintessence. He wields the strongest Dark magic tome in his specific game, Ereshkigal.

Nuibaba is an enemy character from Fire Emblem Gaiden and its remake, Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia. Recently allied with the Duma Faithful, she is known as the mistress of Fear Mountain, who sold her soul for the power of Medusa. She is 124 years old according to internal data for Echoes.

Poe is a character originating in the trading card game, Fire Emblem 0 (Cipher). She is a noble fighting against the power of the Boundless Chaos as an agent of the gods. Poe is known for having a polite and elegant personality, but being incredibly ruthless against those deemed evil. As a mage, she specializes in warp magic.

The (German: Maschinengewehr 42; English: Machine Gun 42) is a German general purpose machine gun designed in 1942 and went into service with the Wehrmacht until 1945. The gun fires the cartridges and was well known for its extremely high rate of fire of approximately 1200 RPM to 1500 RPM, proved to be one of the most effective machine guns of World War II. Since its original iteration, the MG 42 was improved multiple times resulting in the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zastava_M53 M53], MG3 and MG74. MG 42's infamous reputation in World War II led to the gun being nicknamed "Hitler's Buzzsaw" by Allied troops.

Rumei is a boss character in Fire Emblem: Thracia 776. He is a Dragon Knight of Thracia who is hired by Gomes and the Mount Violdrake Bandits. He is fighting to feed his three children, and if captured by Leif and released, promises to support his children with a real job from now on.

Tatarrah is an enemy boss character in Fire Emblem Gaiden, and its remake, Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia. He is a member of the Duma Faithful who guards the sluice gate on the border of Zofia and Rigel. With Delthea under his hypnotic suggestion and himself being in possession of the Death spell, Tatarrah is a fearsome foe in battle.
Stone Golem is the promoted version of the Golem class and appears exclusively in TearRing Saga: Utna Heroes Saga.

The MAT-49 is a French 9x19mm Parabellum submachine gun designed by Manufacture Nationale D'Armes de Tulle in 1949. It was designed to be cheap so it could be manufactured in large numbers and effectively be standard issue to French forces to replace the MAS-38. It was used during the First Indochina War between France and the Viet Minh and, following the Viet Minh victory, many MAT-49s were captured and converted to fit 7.62x25mm Tokarev rounds, then available in large numbers from the Soviet Union and China. It was eventually replaced by the FAMAS in French forces in 1979.
Valter is a boss character from Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones. Also known as the Moonstone, he is one of the strongest generals in Grado's Imperial army, both in the past and the present.

Vampa is an enemy character in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War. She is the leader of Duke Bloom's sister magi squad, consisting of herself, Fetra, and Eliu. Each of the sisters specializes in a particular type of magic, Vampa's being Fire. The three sisters appear in both Chapters 7 and 8, and will die in the latter chapter while facing off against Seliph's army.

Zeed is a Wyvern Rider of Bern, leader of "Zeed's Wyvern Squadron" and older brother of the mage Jemmie. He originates from the Fire Emblem: Hasha no Tsurugi manga and has several encounters with its protagonists. Although he fights for Bern's campaign to conquer Elibe, he is capable of kindness, even to his enemies.

The , abbreviated as the M21 SWS or simply M21, is a marksman rifle adaptation of the M14, designed in 1969. The United States Military chose the M14 for its reliability, accuracy, and the power of the 7.62mm cartridge to become its primary marksman rifle following the Vietnam war. The modification was achieved by simply attaching a 3-9x variable zoom optic and by using National Match-grade ammunition with the weapon. It was the U.S. Army's primary marksman weapon until 1988, when it was officially replaced by the M24, but still saw some use during the Iraq War. Additionally, a newer version of the rifle, the M25, is used by some special forces units.

Yoram is a mentioned character in the Tellius Series. She was the daughter of Meshua, granddaughter of Altina and the first Apostle of Begnion. In the year -95 of the Begnion calendar, she predicted the arrival of a great famine, which indeed appeared and confirmed her prediction. Later she was worshiped as the one who could converse with the Goddess. Yoram was the daughter of the first Branded, in addition to being one herself. es:Yoram
Fleetfoot Ken is an to in Fortnite: Save the World. He is a part of the [https://fortnite.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Core_Heroes Core Heroes] Set.
Flash A.C. is a in Fortnite: Save the World. He can be obtained from , available during the Flannel Falls Venture Season. He is part of the Lunar New Year Heroes Set.

The Remington Model 11-87, is a gas-operated, semi-automatic shotgun, first announced in 1987. The weapon is based upon the Remington Model 1100. Like the Model 1100, the M11-87 has a mechanism which reduces recoil that would be otherwise present (stretching the force out over a much longer period of time than fixed-breech shotguns). The M11-87 can fire 12g and 20g, and is capable of firing most types of loads. The Model 11-87 appears in as the M11-87. Despite its name, the weapon is modeled after the Model 870 and functions as a pump-action shotgun in-game.
Mari is a character in Fortnite: Save the World that represents the Ninja class. Her model is used in the following Heroes: *Dim Mak Mari *Energy Thief Mari
Robin Glider is a Glider. Robin Glider is equipped when using the the Wingshot Grappler.
Subzero Zenith is a in Fortnite: Save the World. He can be purchased from the Event Store for during the Frozen Fjords Venture Season. He is a part of the Holiday Heroes Set.

The M3 Half-track was an armored personnel carrier used by the United States, British Empire and other Allies during World War II and the Cold War. Nearly 43,000 were produced and supplied to the US Army and USMC, as well as British Commonwealth and Soviet Red Army forces serving on all fronts throughout the war. __TOC__

First Lieutenant Kirk Graham, aka Wizard, is an intelligence officer with the Ghosts. Wizard is described as having worked with Scott Mitchell so long that the two seemingly know each other's thoughts. Wizard briefs Nomad's team alongside Mitchell for their mission in Venezuela. Following a bar brawl, he recommended Holt for admission into the elite unit. In 2024, he directly supports Scott Mitchell around the time of the Raven's Rock coup. He is considered by fellow soldiers to be "nerdy".
The Nine Daughters of Ægir and Rán are the Norse Goddesses of Waves.

Mari was a female Vanir worshiper of the Goddess Freya, she was patiently waiting for Freya to return to Vanaheim in hopes Freya would heal her from her sickness, Mari was unaware she was already dead.

The M18 Recoilless Rifle is a shoulder-fired launcher used against armored vehicles and heavy cover that was made by the United States during World War II and the Korean War. It fires 57mm high explosive anti-tank (HEAT) rounds and can penetrate up to 64mm of armor.

= Revenant Hag = Revenant Hags are powerful, witch‑like enemies encountered in God of War Ragnarök and represent an advanced form of the Revenant enemy archetype. As practitioners of corrupted seiðr magic, they have forsaken virtually all of their humanity in exchange for arcane power, making them dangerous adversaries on the battlefield.
Svartáljǫfurr was the Dark Elf King of Alfheim and a boss in God of War (2018).

The Desert Sirens are a trio of sirens who roam the sand-swept desert of lost souls. When Kratos arrives in the desert, Athena tells him that he must find and destroy the three desert sirens to find Cronos. To do this, Kratos needs to follow their song and find them. The first of them is always alone and is located in the same place, in front of the entrance to the Desert Ruins that serves as a passage to the next section of the Desert. The others roam the arenas singing endlessly, until Kratos finds them. Initially, these creatures are alone, but after hitting and killing one of them, attacks on the remaining sirens will summon two minotaurs, making fighting difficult. Unless the siren is killed, the minotaurs will keep respawning. Kratos kills the sirens by wearing them down with his normal attacks, then grabs them and then breaks their spinal column. When the Desert Sirens are killed they release their soul which is then absorbed by the portal, acting as keys. Destroying all three sirens opens door leading to the Ruins.

The M2 Flamethrower is an American made backpack flamethrower that shoots burning jellied petroleum from a gas tank attached to a tube, propelled by nitrogen gas. It was used by American forces by 1943 in World War II and saw service up until 1978 in the Vietnam War.

Stymphalian Birds are giant, monstrous and metallic-winged armored birds that are native to Arcadia. They appear as sub-bosses in God of War: Sons of Sparta. There are three Stymphalian Birds named: Ioke, Ponea and Apate.

The Pale One was a minor boss in God of War Ragnarök. It was a dragon in Niflheim and assists The Raven Keeper against Kratos and Freya. It is implied that the Raven Keeper had imprisoned The Pale One, much like she did her ravens.
Lady Ana was a minor noble, and a member of the Forward Order in the Caligo Forest on Dominaria. She was the mentor of Liliana Vess, widely renowned for her healing abilities.

The M48 Patton is an American medium tank produced between 1952 and 1959 and in service with the United States military from 1953 to 1990. The M48 was designed to replace the M4 Sherman, M26 Pershing, and M47 Patton tanks. It was used extensively by American and South Vietnamese forces during the Vietnam War. The earlier variants used a 90mm gun as its main cannon and an M2 Browning as a co-axial machine gun. The M48A3 variant could include a large xenon searchlight above the barrel, which aided significantly in battles during the night. Certain M48s were also modified into M67 "Zippo" tanks, which was basically a normal M48A2 or -A3 armed with a flamethrower. __TOC__

Marshal Barktooth Warbeard was an old soldier from the kentsu. He lead the occupation force on Kusho, but was killed and replaced by the shapeshifter Halfdane, who had been ordered by his master Ramses Overdark to infiltrate the kentsu. According to legend, Barktooth fought a hydra.

Ben-Ben (BEHN-behn; ) was a foul-smelling outcast akki hermit on Kamigawa. An eccentric goblin, he was smarter than the average akki and known to wear an octopus on his head and carry lotus flowers. He possessed the ability to manipulate stones with his mind through a ritual he performed by wheezing and coughing.

Ashling was a female flamekin on a pilgrimage through Lorwyn, serving occasionally as a messenger for various races. She was searching for a greater elemental, a mythical embodiment of higher nature principles, whose call she subconsciously followed, though she did not know where it may lead.

The M151 MUTT (Military Utility Tactical Truck), is an American light utility vehicle designed by Ford Motor Company within the 1950s, and was the successor to the M38A1 in the American armed forces. Put into production in 1959, the M151 served in the Vietnam War with the United States and the South Vietnamese armed forces, and was also sold to many NATO countries. It used a 71-horsepower engine and incorporated independent suspension, which gave it all-terrain capabilities. Some variants of the M151 include ones carrying recoilless rifles, TOW missiles, and machine guns. __TOC__
Doc Aurlock is a grizzled bearfolk druid who arrived on Thunder Junction after the opening of the Omenpaths.
Bartek is a young, tall and strong crate loader on Ravnica who fell into a setup by the Bane Alley broker Andra.
Baki was a dwarven wizard attendant of unknown gender from the Council of Wizards on the Floating Isle on Ulgrotha around the time of the Homelands (ca. 3800 AR).

The is a German machine gun designed by in 1934. It fires ammunition at a rate of approximately 850 rounds per minute. It was often mounted onto vehicles; German tanks would use them as co-axial machine guns. They also found use as anti-air guns due to their extremely high rate of fire. Soviet and French forces captured many during World War II, and through trading, found their way into use by the Chinese, Korean and Vietnamese forces.

Biracazir was the wolf mount of the ledev wolfrider Fonn Zunich on Ravnica. He was sired by Voja. Biracazir was present during the Decamillennial convocation at Vitu-Ghazi and was a first-hand witness of Szadek's return. Biracazir attacked the ancient vampire, but was seriously wounded. When Szadek attempted to drain Mat'Selesnya's life energy, bringing the Selesnyan parun at the brink of death, Fonn used the green gem from Saint Bayul, that connected an individual's mind to the mind of the Conclave. Biracazir's lifeforce helped to recreate Mat'Selesnya's strength. After the new dryad conclave was spawned by the parun to replace the group killed by Szadek, Biracazir remained at Vitu-Ghazi as its protector and overseer.

The unnamed Dominarian golem that was nicknamed "Boom" was used by the men of Captain Hask as a form of siege engine and heavy duty fighter sometime after the Phyrexian Invasion. He once helped defeat a group of Yotian Soldiers and later fought against the dragon Zumaki.

Brand was a planeswalker. Knowing his Outer Ring was threatened, Brand became desperate for a way to keep from losing it to another wizard. He sought support from his friend Mindrel and told her he planned to learn dark magic. Mindrel tried to talk him out of it by explaining the dangers. However, Brand did not heed her warning. Brand returned home where he met his challenger. He used dark magic that destroyed both him and his plane, and his familiar died curled up by the fireplace. It is unlikely that Brand's opponent was defeated.

The MK-15 Bandit is a fast attack vehicle, or FAV, used by the European Union during The Cold War and is featured in Battlefield 2142. The driver only has access to capability and the vehicle horn. The gunner has a light machine gun turret to repel infantry. A third passenger has access to all of their personal equipment. Though protected by light armor, all passengers are exposed to some degree. Positioned in a rear interior seat, the gunner is the best protected. The passenger is highly exposed. The vehicle does not carry Active Defense System or any missile warning system.
Brallin is a Human Shaman from Ikoria. He is bonded with the monstrous Shark Bird Shabraz.
Bristly Bill is a cactusfolk druid from Thunder Junction. He uses his skills in magic to tend to the cacti and natural flora of the frontier plane.

Chainer was a Dominarian pit-fighter and a dementia caster for the Cabal. As a cabalist, the name "Chainer" was a nickname, while his real (secret) name was Mazeura. Chainer was the first person known to have found the Mirari on Dominaria. Initially, he was able to resist its lure, but ultimately he became obsessed with it and was consumed by its power.

The (German: Machinegun 131) or MG 131 is a heavy machine gun designed by Rheinmetall-Borsig in 1938 and was produced from 1940 to 1945 by Nazi Germany during World War I. It was one of the lightest heavy machine guns available at the time, and was chambered in HE 13x64mmB rounds. Its rate of fire was 900 rounds per minute and was mounted on various vehicles such as the Ju-88, as well as deployed as turreted weapons in infantry battles.
Caliphear the Nightmare was a black horse with flames for her mane and tail living on Corondor.

Chiyo was a soratami prophet, tactician and warrior from Kamigawa. She was the most advanced disciple of Uyo, the silent prophet, and a devoted follower and a right hand of Mochi, the Smiling Kami of Crescent Moon, the patron spirit of soratami.

Chaney was an archdruid during Modern Times on Aerona on Dominaria. By her own accord she was able to planeswalk but hadn't done so in many years. She healed Greensleeves' broken ankle and Gull's knee. Chaney taught Greensleeves how to harness mana and planeswalking. During her training, Greensleeves found out that time in Chaney's house flew differently and what seems to be mere days, were indeed years. When Gull and the rest of the army finally found her, Greensleeves had grown up and become a much more skilled wizard. Chaney suffered a severe stroke, with half her body limp. In her dying moment, her life force was absorbed by Greensleeves. Three years later, Chaney returned as a shade, urging Greensleeves to make the "final sacrifice". After Greensleeves dons the Stone Brain and finds out that its ultimate secret is buried somewhere in the ruins of the College of Lat-Nam, Chaney's shade passes in the afterlife.

The M145 Machine Gun Optic (MGO), a variant of the C79 optical scope used widely by the Canadian Forces, is a small arms scope manufactured by ELCAN Optical Technologies with 3.4x28 magnification. It was developed for the Canadian Army and adopted by the United States Army. It is commonly mounted on M240 and M249 SAW machine guns.

The Coiled One is a powerful, mysterious, and ancient snake god "of venom and vengeance" from Innistrad associated with dark magic. It appears to embody darkness and chaos, capable of exerting control and influence through serpentine symbols and artifacts, such as the mask Sinnia found. The Coiled One's presence is oppressive and tangible, affecting the environment and those around it.

Cecilee was a blonde elven druid who tried to make a Selesnyan enclave in the Rubblebelt of Ravnica. She had a connection with the Worldsoul of Ravnica, and followed its voice through her work, but during an attack by Rakdos cultists, Cecilee was killed by Massacre Girl.
Cyril Rav was a necro-alchemist from Innistrad whose use of a geist-bomb turned him into a geist that could possess people's bodies.

The M35A1, also known as the Nancy, is an improvised fighting vehicle based on the M35 2½ ton truck used as a cargo transport during the Vietnam War. The M35A1 variant is fitted with the M55 Quadmount with four M2 Browning machine guns used primarily as an anti-aircraft weapon in the back, and a single Coaxial M2 Browning in the front. The vehicle was used to protect supply convoys from being attacked by the NVA and Viet Cong during the war. Although convoys were still raided with these in escort, the US lost far less convoy vehicles to raids after they were employed.
Davriel Cane is the pseudonym of a mysterious diabolist, shadowmage and planeswalker living in Kessig on Innistrad.
Dokai (DOH-keye), Weaver of Life, is a human monk of Kamigawa from the time of the Kami War.
El-Hajjâj (EL ha-JAJ) was a powerful wizard from Rabiah, and possibly one of the few people not copied in the Thousand-fold Refraction.

The M82, also known as the "Light Fifty" for its .50 caliber BMG cartridge, is a recoil-operated, semi-automatic anti-materiel rifle developed by the American Barrett Firearms Manufacturing company. A heavy SASR (Special Application Scoped Rifle), it is used by many military units and armies around the world. Variants of the M82 appear in four games in the Battlefield series, as well as being cut content from . The M82A3 appears in Battlefield Play4Free, , and . The M82A1 .416 Barrett appears in as the M82 .416, using the same model as the Battlefield 4 M82A3.
Estrid is a planeswalker introduced in Commander 2018. Estrid wears many faces, only occasionally wearing her own. She is an enchantress, able to hide herself and others behind a mask.

Emiel the Blessed is a legendary unicorn from the Adarkar Wastes, on the plane of Dominaria. Adarkar unicorns were considered the noblest creature in Terisiare, and seeing them was considered a great blessing. Kjeldoran priests thought that seeing a unicorn would protect you from any future harm. Others say that it would be the start of eight years of luck. Even if the details of the blessing differ, they all agree that seeing a unicorn forever changes one's life for the better. Unicorns think the same about seeing Emiel.
Erayo (eh-RYE-oh), Soratami Ascendent, was a moonfolk monk of kamigawa.

The is a German light machine gun produced by Heckler & Koch. It was designed as a machine gun variant of the HK416, and is compatible with standard STANAG magazines. It is currently in USMC service alongside the M249 SAW and M240.

Gavi is a human shaman on the plane of Ikoria. Instead of living in one of the sanctuaries, Gavi lived in the monster-infested wilds of Raugrin. There, she was adopted as a surrogated mother by a litter of baby cat dinosaurs, displaying a connection to the creatures of Ikoria that even bonders envy: she demands the respect-and often fierce devotion of even the most ferocious dinosaurs that roam Raugrin’s crags. The mother cat dino had been killed by a hunter, and the eggs had just hatched when Gavi happened upon the nest. Consequently, the brood imprinted upon her and followed her around everywhere she went. Gavi protects them from any threat or monster happening to find them. Now, Gavi spends her days in the wilds, passing on her knowledge to her adopted brood of monsters. Those who mistake her calm demeanor for weakness tend to realize their error as they are devoured by cat dinosaurs. She is one of the few humans that had earned the respect of the planeswalker Vivien Reid.
Gadrak, the Crown-Scourge, is a dragon from an unknown plane.
Francisco is a bird pirate of the Brazen Coalition on Ixalan.

The M224 Mortar, full name M224 60mm Lightweight Company Mortar System (LWCMS), is a squad-level indirect fired weapon that fires 60mm shells in a high angle arc. It is currently used by the United States Army and Marine Corps.
Frankie "the Fang" is a Vampire outlaw who traveled to Thunder Junction between 4562 and 4563 AR, where she has a bounty outstanding. After entering the plane, she joined the Hellspurs.

Greel was a strange humanoid horror controlled by the Keldons during the Keldon Invasion of Jamuraa on Dominaria. Greel fed off the life force of others, which then caused him to rapidly grow, changing from a young boy to an adult in a matter of weeks. He served as a familiar for Erissa and Latulla to aid in their spellcasting. His origins are unknown. Greel is mainly noteworthy for killing Rayne. He was killed by Barrin, husband of Rayne, soon after.
Golden-Tail () was a taciturn kitsune kensei (master swordsman) from Kamigawa.

The (EMR) is a semi-automatic, gas-operated rifle chambered for the cartridge. It is modified and a more accurate version of the M14 rifle. The M39 succeeded the M14 DMR in USMC service. The "basic" EMR without any attachments or accessories weighs 13 pounds (5.9 kg) or less. The M39 EMR appears in four entries in the Battlefield series.

Gleemax is the name for the mythical giant alien brain in a jar that secretly runs Magic: The Gathering R&D. He is said to occupy “The Forbidden Room” in an underground lair below the corporate offices. It is an in-joke among the staff of Wizards of the Coast.

The Grugg brothers were three thrulls — Elbeph, Bephel, and Phleeb — who were servants of Teysa Karlov and accompanied her to the Utvara Reclamation Zone. Despite some of them being killed several times, Teysa always revived them. Only Bephel was able to speak at first, but Teysa later granted the gift of speech to Phleeb as well, in order to get information. She later created two more thrulls to join the original trio, dubbed Lepheb and Heblep.
Ghave (/ɡeɪv/ gayv), Guru of Spores, is the mycoid heroic shaman of the fungus and saproling in the war against the humans of Drakkus.

The M3 Gun Motor Carriage was a tank destroyer used by Allied forces in WWII. The GMC was a modified M3 Halftrack APC fitted with a 75mm gun. It saw use under the US Army in the Philippines, North Africa and Italy, and was used to some extent by other Allies at the Western front. It was removed from service in 1944.

Gorev Hadszak is a retired Wojek on the plane of Ravnica. Grizzled in every sense of the word—his face, and of unknown age, but despite his gray hair and weathered features, he still looks like he could wrestle a drunken ogre out of a bar or knock out a Rakdos spiker. His wrists were as thick as most men's calves and his arms were covered in scars.

Hayokai was one of the kittens of the Nekoru Wasitora on Dominaria. His name means Swiftly Striking, from which Kolo Meha derived his nickname, "Swifty". He was midnight black, and the brute of the five kittens.

Hythonia is a gorgon who resides on the plane of Theros and has a deep connection to the serpentine god Pharika. She is known by others as "Hythonia the Cruel", as she delights in transforming living creatures to stone and adding them to her throne.

The M1128 Mobile Gun System is a modified Stryker, which in turn is a modified MOWAG Piranha. It utilizes a 105mm rifled cannon and is designed to provide direct fire-support to troops in low-level conflicts and light anti-armor support. It is also designed to be air-mobile, so it can be part of a rapid reaction force.

Haaach is a criminal goblin berserker from Alara who became wanted on Naya. He has been known as Haaach of the Bloodhall, The Hackblade, What the Hell Was That?, and The Piranha of Valeron. He has been wanted for twelve infractions of Bant war laws - including three aggravated prayer violations and five instances of dishonorable initiation of force outside the lawful hours of wartime, possession of a stolen weapon, assault with a jagged golden sword, and speeding.
Homura (HOH-moo-rah), Human Ascendant, was a human monk of Kamigawa from the time of the Kami War.
Angelic Harold is a legendary Angel Performer from Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun.

The M142 High Mobility Artillery Rocket System (HIMARS) is a US light multiple rocket launcher mounted on a standard Army Medium Tactical Vehicle (MTV) truck frame. The HIMARS carries six rockets or one Army Tactical Missile System (ATACMS) missile on the US Army's new Family of Medium Tactical Vehicles (FMTV) five-ton truck, and can launch the entire M270 Multiple Launch Rocket System (MLRS) family of munitions. It is also interchangeable with the MLRS M270A1, carrying half the rocket load. __TOC__
Jenrik was a mysterious astronomancer living in a tall tower on the Silver Beach of Innistrad's province of Nephalia.
Ink-Eyes () was a legendary ninja rat, the most feared ninja on Kamigawa.

Illuna, the Wish-Giver is the apex monster of the Ketria triome on Ikoria. Illuna is an ethereal being with the power to weave dreams and grant wishes, who floats through Ketria from crystal to crystal. Little is known for certain about Illuna, and what is known seems to defy the logic of the waking world. Illuna is said to quite literally make dreams come true, though it seems to bestow its gifts entirely at its own whim. The planeswalker Vivien Reid is one of the few who have heard Illuna's voice. She spotted Illuna floating through Ketria, murmuring softly. Although she thought her vantage point was obscured, Illuna stared at her, as if it were assessing her very soul. Illuna's cry is an unforgettably beautiful chord that seems to harmonize with the world itself. There is an ancient tale of Illuna conjuring a creature from dreams, but the creature is different with every recounting.

The M8 Light Armored Car was a 6x6 armored car produced by the Ford Motor Company during World War II. It was used by the US and British troops in Europe and the Far East until the end of the war. The vehicle was widely exported and as of 2006 still remains in service in some third world countries.
Isobel was an angel of Innistrad who was a part of The Flight of Alabaster led by Bruna.
Jaraku (JAH-rah-koo), the Interloper, is a kami spirit of Kamigawa.
Iris, the Oracle of Ephara is a blind seer from Meletis on the plane of Theros.

The (SLAM) is a "smart" anti-tank mine equipped with magnetic and infrared sensors to detect the presence of vehicles and attack from either the top or side of the mine. Upon detonation, it propels a copper explosively formed penetrator at high velocity to penetrate up to 40mm of armor. It weighs only one kilogram, making it easily man-portable. The SLAM is produced in three versions. The M2 SLAM will self-neutralize itself after a set time interval, whereas the M4 SLAM will self-detonate after a set time interval. The M3 can only be used in the command detonation mode. The M4 SLAM is the variant most often used by the United States military. __TOC__
Visionary Kadesha was leader of the town of Hamath on Corondor (Dominaria). The House of Kadesha was the throne of Pearl Magic.

Kei Takahashi was a Dominarian healer-in-training with the natural magical ability to sense danger and to prevent damage. He was the student of Ayesha Tanaka and the healer of Tetsuo Umezawa's entourage.

Jorgan Hage was an Aerathi berserker from Dominaria. He served in the Kentsu, first as the second in command, later as general. Hage was infuriated when Ramses Overdark remarked that the Kentsu had fallen deeply to let barbarians like the Ærathi in its ranks. He ambushed him, but the assassin proved too powerful. Overdark infused Hage with black mana, making the berserker his minion, but erased all knowledge of their encounter from Hage's mind. For a while Overdark let Hage continue as normal, fighting as Marhault Elsdragon's second in command, but when Elsdragon had no further purpose in Overdark's plans, he had Hage decapitate the general and claim the title. Thus Overdark had replaced a general loyal to the emperor with a general loyal to himself. Hage quickly promoted his own tribesmen to commanders and marshals, but after a gigantic defeat on Argenti he was called back to defend the Imperial Shrine in which Overdark was stationed. When Tetsuo Umezawa showed up, declaring he wanted vengeance on Overdark, Jorgan had his army attack the lone warrior, but Tetsuo called down a meteor shower that killed everyone but the black-mana infused Hage and himself. Hage and Tetsuo fought, a battle in which Tetsuo was victorious. Later Tetsuo used Hage's warhammer in his Meteor Hammer spell.

The (German: Maschinengewehr 4; English: Machine Gun 4) is a German belt-fed light machine gun designed and manufactured in 2001 by . It has been selected by the German Bundeswehr to replace the MG3 general purpose machine gun at the squad support level, but complement the MG3 in many other roles. One of the variants of the MG4 in service is known as the HK123K, with its primarily modification being a shorter barrel.

Kaya Cassir, a.k.a. the Ghost-Assassin, is a human planeswalker from Tolvada with a growing reputation as an accomplished ghost hunter. She was the nominal guildmaster of the Orzhov Syndicate on Ravnica between 4560 and 4562 AR. For an undisclosed reason, she cannot use her family name. On Kaldheim, she was called Kaya Far-Traveler and Slayer of the Bloodsky Sire.

Grandfather Karlov was the greediest of the Orzhov Oligarchs in life. As a ghost he was a member of the Obzedat, the oligarchy that ruled the Orzhov Syndicate on Ravnica. His house sigil was a serpentine ouroboros.
Karador Ghost Chieftain is a legendary centaur spirit from an unspecified plane.

The M4A1 Mortar Motor Carriage was a vehicle utilized by Allied forces during World War II. The vehicle was a variant of the M2 Half Track, equipped with 81mm M1 Mortar. The mortar was intended to be fired dismounted from the vehicle, but could be fired in an emergency to the rear from a base inside the vehicle. The A1 modification allowed the weapon to be fixed facing forward and fired from within the vehicle.

Kaheera, the Orphanguard is a legendary cat beast from the plane of Ikoria. When a human hunter slays a monster, they usually leave that monster's offspring to fend for themselves. Kaheera seems driven by instinct to protect any and all young it comes across, and it raises its diverse brood (formed by monsters from every dominant clade of Ikoria) as its own. Kaheera fought in defense of Ikoria during New Phyrexia's Invasion of the Multiverse.
Jorn is the Skoti god of winter. He is an exceptional tracker who knows the swiftest, safest paths across (and between) every realm.
Katilda is a strong-willed witch from Innistrad. She is the leader of the Dawnhart Coven.

The Fabrique Nationale M3M, also known as the GAU-21, is a belt fed, .50 caliber aircraft gun. It is a modernized version of the Browning M3, a heavily modified version of the M2 Browning intended for aircraft use. It fires significantly faster than the M2 at 1200 rounds per minute via a mechanically boosted feed mechanism. The M3 was heavily used in the 1940s and 1950s on fighter jets until it was replaced with 20mm Cannons, and saw significant action with American pilots during the Korean War. The M3M is currently used by the United States Marine Corps on the UH-1Y Venom under the GAU-21 designation.
Kairi is a dragon spirit from Kamigawa. He is the reincarnation of Keiga.

Ojer Kaslem is the Oltec god of growth and cultivation. As one of the Deep Gods of Ixalan's Core, she is believed to be a child of Chimil. She is one of the lesser gods, primarily worshipped by the Gardener Order.
Kharis is a dragon wizard from an unknown plane that was seen through the Eyes of a Beholder.

The Desert Tech MDR (Micro Dynamic Rifle) is a modular American bullpup rifle that entered production in 2016. The MDR is an ambidextrous rifle intended for military and Law Enforcement use, and features a unique forward ejection system for spent shell casings. The MDR has two configurations, the standard variant and a CQC compact variant (MDR-C). The 5.56x45mm MDR appears in Battlefield Hardline, named the MDC in-game and firing the 7.62x39mm cartridge.

Kal is an ambitious and inquisitive Gruul shaman and member of the Zhur-Taa clan on Ravnica. In addition to his shamanic magic, he is also trained as a hunter, able to move silently and stalk attentive prey.
Keimon was a vedalken stormcaller from Esper, who discovered first-hand the powerful effects of the Maelstrom.

Kiku (KEE-koo; ) was a woman from the Numai swamps on Kamigawa, skilled in both the way of the warrior and in magic. She mastered several weapons, most notably the fuetsu throwing axe and tessen fan. The most deadly, however, are her magic abilities. She used purple camellia blooms that, imbued with her magic, could dig their roots through any living tissue or produce a fragrant smell capable of paralyzing the victim. She was titled jushi or mahotsukai, terms used for the spellcasters of Numai.

The Beretta Model 12 is a 9×19mm Parabellum caliber Submachine gun designed by Beretta. Production began in 1962 and was first purchased by the Italian army that same year. It was first used in combat in 1968 during the Tet Offensive of the Vietnam War, when the Marines guarding the U.S. embassy in Saigon repelled the assault by the Viet Cong. It is also used by various South American and African countries, and made under license in Brazil by Taurus and in Indonesia by PT Pindad. The Model 12 was redesigned as the Model 12S in 1978, using a 32-round box magazine and chambered for the 9×19 mm NATO cartridge. The Model 12S appears in Battlefield Hardline as the M12S.

Lammasu is a bizarre creature type with the body of a bull, a bird's wings and a human head with horns, based on the Mesopotamian creatures of the same name (and appearance). So far, three lammasu have been printed, all associated with white mana.
Kuhnde is a former mantis rider, and a prospective phoenix rider of the Jeskai Clan in the original timeline of Tarkir. It is unknown if he exists in Tarkir's new timeline.
Kwaro was an aven veteran, a sentinel of Arashin, and Khan Anafenza's loyal captain of the guard in Tarkir's original timeline. It is unknown if he exists in Tarkir's new timeline.

The , more commonly referred to as the Trench Gun or simply the M1897 is a pump-action Shotgun designed by . It is an improvement to the Winchester Model 1893. The weapon was popular among American soldiers during World War I, and at one point was protested by Germans over its usage, as they said it violated the rules of war.

Lily, sometimes referred to as Lily the White, was a wizard from Dominaria. She was the wife of Gull and had two children with him. Lily was born into poverty and prostitution, sold by her mother. She was supposedly hired by Towser to be in his harem. He hired her because she showed magical prowess by wearing an amulet that noticed any magic. When Gull and Greensleeves joined Towser's caravan, Gull fell in love with Lily. When Towser's convoy finally reached a coastal city, the three left his employment. However, the power-hungry wizard was scheming to steal Greensleeves' powers. He kidnapped the girls and teleported Gull to a remote tropical island. Just in time, Lily discovered her magical ability to summon Gull back. Towser was defeated, and afterward, along with Greensleeves, began to create an army to fight evil wizards.

Countess Liliana Vess is a human planeswalker from Dominaria and is both a master necromancer and a healer. For a while, she was dead to the Multiverse, her survival known only to select members of the Gatewatch. Having freed herself from all her demonic contracts as well as from the Onakke Chain Veil, she relocated to Fiora where she temporarily lived under the alias Ana Iora. On Arcavios she was originally known as Professor Serafina Onyx, before reclaiming her original name, and began taking steps to reclaim her ancestral Dominarian home. The Raven Man and Chandra affectionally call her Lili.

Merieke Ri Berit was a mysterious figure who lived during the Ice Age in Terisiare on Dominaria. Little is known about her, save that she was a temptress who used magical powers to ensnare other creatures. Her race is in doubt; she is officially noted as a human, but her art depicts her as an elf.

The Bergmann Model 1915 n.A. (German: neue Art; English: New Model) is a German air-cooled Machine Gun used during World War I. Lighter and more compact than the Maxim machine gun, the MG15 went through several design iterations until the n.A. model was accepted by the Imperial German Army in 1916 to meet troop demands for a lighter machine gun. Filling a role in the German arsenal similar to the Allies' Lewis Gun, the MG 15 was generally less reliable in the field than its counterparts, usually overheating after firing 300 rounds. The MG 15 was put out of production with the end of the Great War in 1918.
Mayael is a female shaman and the de facto leader of the Cylian elves from Alara. On Naya, she is also known as the Anima.

The infamous Baron Sengir is a vampire lord, ruling the Dark Barony on Ulgrotha from Castle Sengir. He is the progenitor of the Sengir vampires that can be found on multiple planes. Notable Sengir vampires include Irini Sengir on Ulgrotha, and Arvad, Kazarov, and Verrak on Dominaria.

Sangrazuls are an anthropomorphic race which have the ability to find mana lines better than even planeswalkers. As such, they serve them often. Currently there is only one known Sangrazul - Malvos, who served the planeswalker Tempé. Sangrazuls have great longevity. They do, however, need to "eat" mana from time to time to survive. Death by starvation, though, is a long process. After at least five hundred years, starving Sangrazul start dying. It's very painful, and months of conscious horror can pass until the immovable, drying body releases its tormented soul. The craving for mana can be held off in the short term by the consuming of sweets, centuries of this behavior leading to morbid obesity.

The is a semi-automatic rifle chambered in that was produced in the United States from 1906 to 1957. During World War I, the weapon was ordered in various numbers by the US, French, British and Imperial Russian armed forces. During World War I, the French Army ordered 2,500 rifles. Allegedly, these were modified for fully automatic fire and doubled the magazine size from 10 rounds to 15-20 rounds in 1917. No evidence of the fully automatic conversion has ever been found.
Sarkhan Vol is a human former planeswalker hailing from Tarkir, a plane scourged by war. He is fascinated by dragons, something that has been a blessing and curse to him throughout his life.

Sethron Hurloon General is a leader among the Hurloon minotaurs, on the plane of Dominaria. Sethron is the first line of defense against any who would invade Hurloon Valley. The sound of his flaming hammer crushing the skull of an invader echoes for miles throughout the Red Iron Mountains. He appears to be left-handed.
Dean Shaile Talonrook is a bird cleric teacher at the Silverquill College of Strixhaven University on Arcavios. She was compleated during New Phyrexia's Invasion of the Multiverse.

M1918 may refer to: *BAR M1918 - A light machine gun featured in Battlefield 1942, Battlefield Vietnam, Battlefield 1 and Battlefield V. **BAR M1918 (Codex Entry) - A Codex Entry featured in Battlefield 1. *Tankgewehr M1918 - An anti-tank rifle featured in Battlefield 1. **Holes Through Steel (Codex Entry) - A Codex Entry featured in Battlefield 1. *Automatico M1918 - A submachine gun featured in Battlefield 1. **Automatico M1918 (Codex Entry) - A Codex Entry featured in Battlefield 1. **Elite Automatico M1918 (Codex Entry) - A Codex Entry featured in Battlefield 1.
Sasaya (SAH-sah-yah), Orochi Ascendant was an enlightened Orochi Monk from Kamigawa who was active during the Kami War.

Sivitri Scarzam was a human Planeswalker who commanded the mighty Scarzam dragons named for her. There used to be some question as to whether she or her dragons were the ones with the power to planeswalk, but that has been cleared up with the release of her planeswalker card in Dominaria United.
Skellum was an old dementia master in the employ of the Cabal on Dominaria. His secret name was Cybariss.
The M1897 Shotgun is a Codex Entry featured in Battlefield 1. It is unlocked upon obtaining 10 kills with the M97 Trench Gun.
Shokol Wenslauv was the skyjek Air Commander of the Tenth Leaguehall on Ravnica.

Sheoldred (Phyrexian: gOcdrd, IPA: [ʃøldrd]), known as the Whispering One was the Praetor of the Black Faction of New Phyrexia. In the year 4562 AR, she led an invasion of the plane of Dominaria, where she attained several important military objectives in preparation for New Phyrexia's Invasion of the Multiverse. After her return to New Phyrexia, however, she lost a power struggle against the Mother of Machines, Elesh Norn. Sheoldred was subsequently captured by Norn's forces and beheaded by Ajani Goldmane.
Sindbad was a famous human explorer from Rabiah, who once used a giant flying bird as a means of transportation, tying himself fast to one of its enormous claws.
The M1907 Selfloading Rifle is a Codex Entry featured in Battlefield 1. It is unlocked upon obtaining ten kills with the M1907 SL.

The Sliver Queen was the center of the sliver hive mind on Rath. The queen was manipulated by Volrath into becoming his minion. But while she was guarding the Legacy items, the silver golem Karn managed to persuade her into giving them to him by telling her they were part of him in the same way that her children were a part of her. She and much of her brood was killed when the Rathi Overlay placed her lair in the heart of a volcano.
Sigarda is an Angel from Innistrad associated with purity and birth and the protection of humans.

Silas Renn was a human, born on the shard of Esper (Alara). He was the heir of the House of Renn, one of the most influential families among the elite of Esper. He was also a member of the Seekers of Carmot and an enemy of Tezzeret. Silas was a clockworking adept.

The is a heavy machine gun used by the United States armed forces in World War I, World War II, Korea, and to a limited extent in Vietnam; it has also been used by other nations. It was a crew served, belt-fed, water-cooled machine gun that served alongside the much lighter air-cooled Browning M1919. The combined weight of the gun (filled with water) and full magazine of 250 rounds would equate to about 100 lbs (45 kg). It was used at the battalion level, and often mounted on vehicles (such as a jeep).
Siani is a djinn from Tarkir's original timeline associated with the Jeskai Way.
Spurna was a goblin embermage of Squee's kingdom, who became Phyrexianized.
Sol, Advocate Eternal, is a dragon angel from an unknown plane.

The was a German triple-barrel hunting rifle developed in 1930 for Luftwaffe pilots as a survival weapon. The M30 incorporates two 12-gauge shotgun barrels over a rifle barrel chambered for the round, a hunting cartridge equivalent to the modern .370 Nitro Express. The weapon was produced until 1942, and was primarily issued to Luftwaffe crews participating in the .

Skoa is a goblin embermage from an unknown plane, possibly Dominaria. As Embermages are common in Jamuraa, and Skoa is mechanically casting , which also depicts a goblin and references being cast by an embermage, it is possible Skoa is from Dominaria.
Soramaro (SOH-rah-MAH-roh; sora 空 "sky" + maro まろ male suffix) First to Dream, is a kami on Kamigawa that was once a human.

Taborax is an infamous demon from Zendikar. In the wake of the rise and fall of the Eldrazi, many people of Zendikar felt that their gods had turned against them. In desperation, those who are already inclined toward wickedness and depravity increasingly turn to the worship and service of demons. Of all the demons, Taborax has amassed the largest following, his cult believing he could singlehandedly protect them from a potential Eldrazi resurgence. Sometimes he shares a small taste of power with his "most devout," but Taborax makes certain he receives much more in turn.

The was a prototype French semi-automatic rifle designed and manufactured by the to replace the French military's older bolt-action rifles. The prototype itself evolved from the MAS-38/39 and MAS-40 rifles and had several variants such as the 44A, 44B, and 44C. The MAS-44 was a gas piston-operated design that had a detachable box magazine. Although 50,000 rifles were ordered by the in January 1945, only 6,300 rifles were delivered, causing the rifle to see limited use during World War II. The MAS-44's direct successor, the , was adopted by the French Army in July 1949 and saw service during the first half of the .

Suniel the Woodwise is an Selesnyan druid and woodshaper on the plane of Ravnica. He sits on the council of high priests of the Conclave, along with Molander, Troslon, Alcarus, and Sadruna, and is famous for having been directly responsible for the creation of the three-dryad unity known as Trostani.
Tamsyn Sweene was a role taken by a shapeshifter agent of House Dimir, who infiltrated Leighbet's discovery of electrical immunity.
Tahngarth was a proud minotaur warrior from Talruum and the first mate aboard the skyship Weatherlight.

The (Italian: Moschetto Automatico Beretta Modello 1938) was an Italian submachine gun used during World War II. Introduced in 1938, it primarily equipped the Royal Italian Army but was also used by other members of the Axis Powers such as Germany and . It was developed from the Beretta M1918.

Terrent Amese, known as "Durran D'mese" among the Scarwood apes, was a human-shaped being who created the first tribe of Jamuraan tiger warriors by fusing the essence of man and tiger. He created them to guard the Dark Heart of the Wood in Scarwood. Deeply religious, these tribes worshiped him, their creator, whom they believed to be a god.
Primus Thriss was a powerful Nantuko druid who became guardian of the Krosan Forest on Dominaria. He convinced Kamahl to abandon his barbarous ways and trained him as a druid.
Tok-Tok (TOHK-tohk; ) was an old akki shaman on Kamigawa famous for his ability to survive almost anything.

The , also known as the M3 Grease Gun because of its resemblance to a mechanic's grease applicator, was a weapon used by the United States Military during World War II. Introduced as a lower cost, lighter and quicker to produce replacement for the Thompson submachine gun, it entered frontline service in 1944. The improved M3A1 variant saw use in later conflicts such as the .

Tojira, a.k.a. the Swamp Queen was a sorceress who magically created the Nightstalkers of Caliman. She discovered dangerous weaponry in various Thran ruins located in a salt marsh in the area of Dakmor. She went on to live there, and waged war on Alaborn.

Thrissik is one of the the Seven Steel Thanes of New Phyrexia. Thrissik believes that Phyrexia must give birth to its destroyer. The destroyer will destroy Phyrexia, so it can be reborn. The cycle must continue because Phyrexia must always be improved and strengthened. With each resurrection from its own ashes, Phyrexia will be stronger than before. Thrissik seeks the Destroyer and wants to place himself as the Father of Machines. After Roxith came to its realm to harvest flesh, Thrissik attacked the Thane in order to determine if he was the "destroyer". Thrissik managed to substantially injure Roxith and concluded he was not the "destroyer".
Toski is a small Cosmos monster from Kaldheim and the messenger of the gods.

The was an American semi-automatic rifle designed by prior to World War II. The weapon was notable for having short recoil operation and a rotary 10-round magazine. Although rejected for large scale US use in favor of the already adopted M1 Garand, it was used by the United States Marine Corps .
Toluz, the Clever Conductor, is a human rogue of the Obscura from Capenna. She has also been known as Light's-Out Luz.

Tiana is a timid Serra Angel artificer from Dominaria, who has become the guardian and chief engineer of the new Skyship Weatherlight as part of Jhoira's crew. She has a natural affinity with the ship and inherent knowledge of its workings.

Vaevictis Asmadi was a large, powerful, and aggressive Elder Dragon. He had a characteristic fierce crest. Vaevictis is sometimes described as a rampaging monster, but he is also called “the Serpent’s Tongue,” and tales are told of his subtle deceptions and twisted layers of deceit.

M3 may refer to: *M3 GMC - A tank destroyer featured in Battlefield 1942. *M3 Grant - A tank featured in Battlefield 1942. *M3 Half-track - A transport vehicle featured in Battlefield 1942 and Battlefield V. *Benelli M3 - A shotgun featured in Battlefield 2: Modern Combat. *M3A3 Bradley - An IFV featured in Battlefield: Bad Company and Battlefield: Bad Company 2. *M3M - A weapon featured in Battlefield Hardline. *M3 Grease Gun - A submachine gun featured in Battlefield V. *M3 Infrared - A weapon featured in Battlefield V.

Vaan was a blue Pixie from Dominaria, about half the size of a human. He was enslaved by a dragon. The dragon Zumaki of the Bottomless Pool had enslaved Vaan and his people to revel in the illusions of their glamour. But Zumaki was attacked by a Mak Fawa, and in the battle, both dragons were killed. Thanks to the infiltration and regeneration powers of the Mak Fawa though, a new dragon rose in their place, with the body of the engine and a twisted version of Zumaki's mind. This new dragon also enslaved Vaan's people, but with its twisted half-sentient mind, it did not realize that the pixies could not survive from mortal wounds as it could. After a few months, it had perfected a way to allow him to resurrect them, but by that time only Vaan was left, the mummified remains of the other 200 of his people stashed away in the deepest reaches of Zumaki's mountain. Vaan was forced to place glamours on the merger-dragon, so the demented beast could pretend he was still the true Zumaki. Vaan was placed under a geas that prevented him from divulging too much information about the dragon. But he was an ingenious pixie, and through roundabout ways and intricate pantomimes of glamour-illusions, he managed to gather together a group of warriors to kill his new master, including potion-master Donner Rus, his apprentice Tania Cayce, the artifact-hating druid Kula, and the crew of Captain Hask, the man who wields the Hand of Righteous Retribution, a magical sword that Vaan thought necessary
Varolz is a fierce troll warrior of the Golgari Swarm on Ravnica. He was chosen as the Golgari maze runner.
Ulrich is the werewolf leader of the Krallenhorde howlpack on Innistrad.

The Howe & Howe Ripsaw is a tracked, unmanned ground combat vehicle undergoing development with the US Army, with the most recent M5 variant being tested as the RCV-M (Robotic Combat Vehicle-Medium). It can be remotely operated, with more recent variants featuring fully autonomous capability, and design tailored to preserve communication even when disabled. Available weapon systems include a 30mm autocannon and anti-tank missiles, as well as less-lethal options for deterrence. Appearing in as the M5C Bolte, it was first seen in the Battlefield 2042 Official Reveal Trailer (ft. 2WEI), seen chasing LCAA Hovercrafts in the ice fields of Breakaway.

Varnel Buckara was the Master of the Orange House of Fentesk, in the city of Estark on Dominaria. He participated in the Night of Fire, the destruction of the House of Oor-tael. He was a very lascivious man, who loved being surrounded by beautiful and young women: in his harem he had more than fifty of them. He was killed by the Grand Master of Arena Zarel, when the latter decided to destroy the four Houses. Zarel cast a spell on Varnel, which caused him to age a hundred years in a matter of seconds, until all that was left of him were his skeletal remains.
Urgoros is a specter from Vhelnish on Dominaria, who serves Belzenlok.
Velomachus Lorehold is one of the five elder dragons from Arcavios that founded Strixhaven. The Lorehold College is named in her honor. She is a master of the magic of order and chaos.

The is a battle rifle produced by . One of several variants of the that use the short-stroke gas piston developed for the earlier MPX, the Spear is chambered for the 6.8×51mm SIG cartridge. In 2021, the weapon was entered into the United States Army's (NGSW) program, and was announced as the winner on April 19, 2022, under the designation XM5 (later changed to ). The prototype model of the MCX Spear appears in Battlefield 2042 as the M5A3, and the production model is featured in Battlefield 6 as the M277 named after the caliber, the commercial counterpart of the 6.8x51mm cartridge.
Volrath, born as Vuel, was a human from Dominaria, who later became the shapeshifting and phyrexianized leader of Rath. He was one of the main antagonists in the Weatherlight Saga.

Vraska (Phyrexian: lreLhFD, IPA: [vraskəʔ]) is a black and green-aligned gorgon assassin and former planeswalker from Ravnica. She was part of a mercenary organization of assassins known as the Ochran. Later she became the Queen of the Golgari Swarm. On Ixalan, she is known as Captain Vraska. She was compleated for a period during the events of Phyrexia: All Will Be One until the defeat of Elesh Norn, after which she was un-compleated but lost her spark in the Desparkening.
Vronos, nicknamed the Gray Fencer, was a planeswalker from Innistrad, who was killed by Garruk Wildspeaker.
The is a German modular assault rifle developed by in 2017. The HK433 is chambered in in its full length variant, and has been adopted for use by the , and has seen combat in the .
Vivien Reid, named the Queen of Ghosts on Ixalan, is a shamanic human planeswalker.

On Lorwyn, Auntie Wort is a shaman and leader of a boggart warden. Wort is not the most stable personality, but she's been around long enough how to keep her boggart younglings out of danger. She always knows which berries can be eaten and which kithkin is easier to trick. Should things go wrong, she can always make more boggarts.

Winota, Heartbonder is a human warrior on the plane of Ikoria. Winota is one of the bonders, humans who form magical connections with the monsters of Ikoria. She told the planeswalker Vivien Reid how she lost her right arm trying to kill the monster that she ended up bonding with. Now Winota and her companion (which resembles a huge plated raccoon) travel Ikoria helping other bonders and monsters learn to fight side by side.

The is an American light machine gun developed in 2019 by to replace the M249 SAW. The M250 designation is the name of the military-adopted version of the SIG LMG 6.8 submitted to the , alongside its counterpart the M7 rifle. The M250 fires the same cartridge as the M7, being the , also known as the .277 Fury.
Vito Quijano de Pasamonte was a heretical vampire hierophant of the Church of Dusk who worshipped Aclazotz on the plane of Ixalan. He was granted demonic power by his god before his death.

Zalgadib was an efreet from Suq'Ata on Dominaria. He defended Ramses Overdark's keep, and in exchange he got to eat Ramses, if he was still alive after the end of the efreet's service. It never came to that, because Zalgadib service would have ended 256 years after the year in which Overdark died. Zalgadib himself was killed by Kolo Meha, who had been sent by Tetsuo Umezawa to destroy Overdark's keep.
Zahid is a djinn from Dominaria. He has blue skin, glowing blue eyes, pointed ears, tattoos, black hair, black eyebrows and a long thin moustache. Sometimes his hair changes into black smoke.
The is an American bolt-action sniper rifle produced by in 2010 chambered in . It was designed and derived from the M24, of which it replaced.
Zaxara, the Exemplary is a legendary nightmare hydra from the plane of Ikoria.
Ysidra is the Adarkar valkyrie who raised Vannemir from the dead to fulfill his destiny and save Terisiare from being destroyed by Heidar.

Auda is a member of the Maganac Corps in Mobile Suit Gundam Wing. He pilots what is perhaps the most unique of the Maganac mobile suits, utilizing a massive left arm with a powerful claw designed to severely damage enemy mobile suits in close range combat.

The is a belt-fed light machine gun developed and manufactured by in 2001. The MG5 started development after the release of the earlier MG4, and was intended to replace the MG3 in then-current service with the German Bundeswehr. The primary development focus of the MG5 was modularity. The MG5 was known as the HK121 during its development. The MG5 A2 variant features a shorter barrel to lighten the overall weight of the weapon, comparitive to the original MG5.
is a genetically enhanced human being introduced in the anime Mobile Suit Gundam SEED.
The is a Gunpla introduced in Gundam Build Metaverse. An upgraded version of the KMK-B01 Kamiki Burning Gundam, it is built and piloted by Sekai Kamiki.

The Samurai Gundam is piloted by Taro Miyajima of Neo Palau. He is the second Gundam pilot to face Sai Saici for possession of the Meteor Butterfly Sword Technique. He has a strong sense of hate for the Gundam Fight and is trying to destroy all Gundams by acquiring the Meteor Sword Techinque. His reason to hate the Gundam Fight is that the Gundam Fight has destroyed nature. This mobile fighter appears in Mobile Fighter G Gundam Side Story: Flying Dragon Legend manga.

The Flocking Floater, also known as Flocking Bloater, is an alien enemy cut from Half-Life. It can be found in the game files.

The is the light machine gun variant of the G36 Assault Rifle. It is fitted with a 100-round Beta C-Mag magazine and a heavy barrel, and fires the standard 5.56mm NATO cartridge like the other variants of the G36 family. A very small batch were made for testing with the Bundeswehr. However, tests concluded that it offered no advantage over a G36 modified for a similar role. Thus, it was rejected, with only about 300 ever produced. Genuine MG36s appear in Battlefield: Bad Company and its sequel Bad Company 2. Its other appearances in other Battlefield games are actually other G36 variants modified with light machine gun features such as bipods and drum magazines (and also top rails) to resemble the MG36.

This unidentified creature is an aquatic predator native to Sanghelios. It possesses several tentacles, similar to those of Earth's cephalopods. After the future Shipmaster knocked his opponent off the boat, the creature noticed the splashes and attempted to drown the Sangheili who had been knocked off of the boat. The Sangheili could not fight against the creature's strength, and presumably drowned and was consumed by the creature. Years later, the Shipmaster expressed no pity for his clanmate, noting that only the worthy would survive.

First-Light-Weaves-Living-Song, better known as the Librarian, was a highly influential Forerunner Lifeshaper and the head of the Lifeworker rate for ten thousand years. She was married to the Didact, the Promethean supreme commander of the Forerunner military. During the Forerunner-Flood war, she led the Conservation Measure, which sought to index all species in the galaxy and transport them to the Ark and other conservation facilities before the Flood could reach them or the Halo rings were fired. Frequently clashing with her husband over the morality of the Array, the Librarian died at the end of the war when the rings were activated, willingly stranding herself on Earth within range of the Halo effect. She viewed the human species as having special significance and is responsible for grooming humanity to be the Forerunners' successors. 100,000 years after the firing of the Halo Array, the Librarian resurfaced through personality imprints to help continue guiding humanity towards the Mantle. The Librarian herself was preserved in the Domain where she would eventually be reunited with her husband.

The Swedish also ordered the MBT LAW in 2005 through the UK MoD's procurement agency as well as several other nations. Deliveries of the system began in 2009. The MBT LAW was designed and developed by SAAB Bofors Dynamics in Sweden.__TOC__

Rukt was a powerful Jiralhanae chieftain of the Rh'tol skein. Rukt eventually claimed the warhammer, and later namesake, Fist of Rukt from roaming bands of marauders. The was a German submachine gun designed by Hugo Schmeisser and manufactured by Theodor Bergmann GmbH. It was among the first practical submachine guns used in combat, adopted by German Army in 1918 during World War I. Although production of the gun ceased at the end of the war, the MP 18 was a highly influential design and served as the basis for many future submachine guns. In 1928, an improved version of the MP 18, known as the MP 28, was introduced.
